## Goal

The deployed service exists and its platform-assigned name carries the `-1qtu`
suffix; the blueprint still describes a domain that returns 404. This card moves
`CORS_ORIGINS` to the real origin so the deployed API's CORS policy matches the
service actually serving traffic - and does it under the EXISTING gate, with
zero gate edits, because the existing gate's CORS leg is a substring check that
the corrected value satisfies. The card's discipline is what it must NOT do: it
must not touch tests[134], and it must not leave `APP_VERSION` unquoted or
change its value.

## Context (measured at groom against the pinned base)

shape claim below. The survey's two ASSUMPTIONS are now MEASURED, and one of

**(1) The base CORS_ORIGINS shape (survey assumption CONFIRMED, exact bytes
now pinned).** `render.yaml` at BASE is 38 lines with CRLF terminators
(`core.autocrlf=true` in this checkout, so `git show` yields LF while the work
tree carries CRLF - every leg here compares in LF space). Line 29 is exactly:

```
        value: "[\"https://expense-tracker-dashboard.onrender.com\"]"
```

a quoted YAML *string* whose content is a JSON array of one quoted element -
the shape Render's own docs use for a JSON-list env var, and the shape
tests[134] parses. It is NOT a YAML flow sequence and NOT a bare host.

**(2) The base APP_VERSION shape (survey/recon claim CORRECTED by
measurement).** The phase_14 recon says the operator "already quoted"
`APP_VERSION` in `ae0e46a`. The BASE blob does not carry that: line 33 is
`        value: 1.0.0` - UNQUOTED. The gate still passes at BASE because
`1.0.0` contains two dots, which no YAML number grammar accepts, so js-yaml
yields the STRING `"1.0.0"` and tests[134]'s `String(value)==="1.0.0"` leg is
GREEN. That is luck, not the contract: the same value written as `1.0` would
parse to the float `1.0` and RED the gate, and the AC text says QUOTED. So the
card's sanctioned edit set is TWO lines - the CORS line (gap G1) and the
APP_VERSION quoting line (gap G2, gate-neutral by measurement) - and ac2
proves the quoted form by the gate's own parse plus the exact raw line, never
by a grep that would also match the unquoted one.

## Constraints (hard)

- ZERO gate edits. `docs/state/merge_test_index.json` is orchestrator-owned and
  this card has NO amendment to hand over (unlike t90). A card that "fixes"
  tests[134] is a FAIL even if the gate goes green; ac3's byte-identity leg is
  the fence that catches it.
- `APP_VERSION`'s VALUE stays `1.0.0`; only the quoting form is mandated
  (ac2's parse leg REDs any value change, its raw-line leg REDs any unquoting).
- `render.yaml` changes on EXACTLY the two sanctioned value lines and nothing
  else: no plan/region/health-path/env additions, no reordering, no comment
  additions, no line-count change (ac4 compares line sets against the BASE
  blob, so an added line REDs even if it is later deleted elsewhere).
- The old no-suffix origin must be GONE from the whole file - not commented,
  not kept alongside the new one (ac1's element leg and ac4's whole-file leg).
- No local-dev origin (`http://localhost:5173` or any other host) is added;
  BASE carries exactly one element and the candidate carries exactly one.
- The delta is single-file: `render.yaml` is the only PRODUCT file. t90's
  `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` operator edit is ANCESTOR-owned - it may sit
  uncommitted in the work tree, it may arrive via a merged ancestor, but it may
  NEVER be committed on this card's branch (measured: committing it REDs ac4).
- Do not touch `README.md` (t94/t96), `ops/**` / script URLs (t93/t98),
  `.github/**` (t90), `docs/criteria/**` (generators), `scripts/**`,
  `tests/**`, `backend/**`, `frontend/**`.
- Do not close, comment on, or relabel any platform issue beyond what groom
  owns; the builder commits only `render.yaml` plus its own card/handoff room.

## Out of scope

- Any change to `docs/state/merge_test_index.json` - including tests[134],
  which this card exists to re-run UNAMENDED, and the parked tests[227]
  README-pin rotation, which is a phase_14 milestone-pin item the orchestrator
  parks separately (its RED predates this card and its render leg never runs).
- The deploy/health closeout evidence (t92), the script-side URL/register
  migrations (t93/t98), the README live-URL backfill and pin moves (t94/t96),
  issue #61 closure (t95), the `/health` version single-source (t97), and the
  deploy-workflow secret re-premise (t90) - none of those files are this
  card's, and ac4's product-delta leg is the fence that says so.
- Render dashboard-side actions (deploy hook firing, service rename, blueprint
  sync in the UI): the platform API surface here is the issue tracker only,
  and the card's contract is the committed blueprint bytes.
- Whether the OLD domain should keep answering: it 404s at the platform; no
  redirect or dual-origin allowance is this card's decision.
